description: This file contains custom encoder functions and related mappings used for serializing various data types to JSON-compatible formats within the FastAPI framework. It includes encoder functions for datetime, Decimal, Enum, IP addresses, UUID, and other types, as well as a core function `jsonable_encoder` that converts objects into JSON-friendly representations, handling Pydantic models, dataclasses, collections, and custom encoders.

methods.name: str isoformat(o: Union[datetime.date, datetime.time])
methods.description: Returns ISO 8601 format string from a date or time object.

methods.name: Union[int,float] decimal_encoder(dec_value: Decimal)
methods.description: Encodes a Decimal as an integer if there's no exponent, otherwise as float, to preserve round-tripping.

methods.name: dict[Callable[[Any],Any],tuple[Any,...]] generate_encoders_by_class_tuples( type_encoder_map: dict[Any, Callable[[Any], Any]], )
methods.description: Builds a dictionary mapping encoder functions to tuples of classes they handle, for efficient type checking.

methods.description: Converts complex objects into JSON-compatible data structures, handling models, dataclasses, collections, and using registered encoders, with options for including/excluding fields and handling nested structures.
